summary: Began a large refactor replacing the workspace-profile concept with a per-project configuration model. Mapped integration points across protocol, agent-server, and app, then started editing: removed `defaultProfile` and profile-related imports/exports from the extension registry, added a `disabledGizmoExtensions` field to `GlobalResourceSettings`, dropped `integrations` from the `project.add` protocol message, and added gizmo-extension catalog and toggle methods in `resource-catalog.ts` (including fixing `setGlobalSkill` writes to spread settings so the new field is preserved).
decisions: Replace workspace-profile concept with a `ProjectConfig` (versioned, with explicit Gizmo extension enablement that inherits global toggles when absent) instead of multiple selectable profiles.
Drop `integrations` from the `project.add` protocol message; new projects inherit global settings and integrations rather than carrying an initial profile.
Add a `gizmoExtensions` listing plus a `setGlobalGizmoExtension` method on `ResourceCatalog` so installed Gizmo extensions can be toggled globally, independent of per-project overrides.
Per-project Pi extension disabling is done by filtering `piExtensionPaths` via project-config overrides (planned, not yet implemented in this segment).
errors: Edit to `global-resource-settings.ts` failed with `Could not find edits[2]`: the oldText used incorrect indentation (extra tab level) for the `read()` return object; retried with correct indentation and succeeded.

Earlier grep `grep -n "defaultProfile" apps/agent-server/src/extensions/registry.ts` exited with code 1 because the python regex had already stripped `defaultProfile` (no matches) — non-fatal, just an exit-code surprise.
